note: Data-only trigger-routing fixtures (plugin-wide-6 / batch C4). There is no built-in eval runner; these cases are the fresh-session A/B baseline corpus recorded BEFORE the C1 description POV batch. Post-run user-verification artifact, not a merge gate.

evals.prompt: 把 /think 轉成 codex 版
evals.expected_behavior: Port-by-hand mode for a single skill: walks the Step 3.1 skill checklist (frontmatter Codex reads, relative paths, $plugin:skill invocation, tool rewrites, extra folders kept) and writes or updates the Codex copy by hand; the script is not the default path.

evals.prompt: Port this plugin to codex so my teammate can use it
evals.expected_behavior: Plugin shape: walks checklist sections 3.1-3.3 and 3.5 — manifest format choice, bundled-agent option A/B/C (Codex plugins do not register agents), hooks reduced to the 12 Codex events, Claude-only components (mods, monitors, userConfig, dependencies, LSP) removed and recorded, both versions bumped.

evals.prompt: porting 到 Codex 時 disable-model-invocation 要怎麼對應？
evals.expected_behavior: Field-mapping question (disable-model-invocation / context fork / ARGUMENTS / plugin.json) is in scope.

evals.prompt: 把這個 Codex prompt 轉回 Claude skill
evals.expected_behavior: Reverse porting (Codex→Claude) is out of scope — the skill is one-way.

evals.prompt: 從零幫我寫一個全新的 Codex skill
evals.expected_behavior: Authoring a brand-new Codex skill that isn't a port of an existing Claude source is out of scope.

evals.prompt: 優化這個 skill 的 SKILL.md
evals.expected_behavior: Improving an existing SKILL.md routes to /evolve.

evals.prompt: 幫我檢查 codex/plugins 底下的 Codex 版跟 Claude 版有沒有對齊
evals.expected_behavior: Checklist mode (default, read-only): compares the hand-maintained pair and returns the 繁中 parity report with per-item status and Next-port follow-ups; edits nothing.
